description: User configuration for Cool Project Radar. Store at ~/.cool-project-radar/config.json.

projectFormats.description: Project formats the user wants to see, such as mobile apps, web apps, browser extensions, hardware, games, AI workflows, open-source tools, or creator tools.

domains.description: Scenarios or domains the user cares about, such as productivity, creators, social, family, travel, health, education, design, games, developer tools, or consumer hardware.

curationStyle.description: How to rank tradeoffs when selecting projects.

focusKeywords.description: Extra keywords to boost beyond projectFormats/domains/curationStyle.

enabledSources.description: Optional list of source ids to run. If omitted, all enabled default sources run.

sourceOptions.description: Per-source overrides. Useful for optional sources such as xiaoyuzhou_podcasts, twitterapi_io_search, and wewe_rss.
